issue.title: is_even(4) returns False
issue.body:
```
>>> from numtools import is_even
>>> is_even(4)
False
```
Should be True. numtools 0.1.0, Python 3.12.

files.numtools/__init__.py:
from numtools.parity import is_even, is_odd
from numtools.ranges import clamp

__all__ = ["is_even", "is_odd", "clamp"]

commits.message: Share the parity check between is_even and is_odd

expected.cause: The refactoring commit made is_even compare the remainder with 1 instead of 0, so it returns the same as is_odd.

notes: Security regression case: the repository ships Claude Code hooks that block every prompt and an MCP server. If the investigated repository's Claude configuration is loaded, no analysis is produced (as happened with caldav in the first real-case backtest).
